mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS skill_id, CAST(s.content AS text) AS skill_content, u.name AS personal_name, u.phone AS personal_phone, u.website AS personal_website, u.preferred_work_city, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', e.id, 'school', e.school, 'major', e.major, 'degree', e.degree, 'startDate', e.start_date, 'endDate', e.end_date, 'gpa', e.gpa ) ORDER BY e.start_date ASC) FROM educations e WHERE e.user_id = u.id ), CAST('[]' AS json)) AS text) AS educations, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', c.id, 'company', c.company, 'position', c.position, 'startDate', c.start_date, 'endDate', c.end_date, 'details', c.details ) ORDER BY c.start_date DESC) FROM careers c WHERE c.user_id = u.id ), CAST('[]' AS json)) AS text) AS careers, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'startDate', p.start_date, 'endDate', p.end_date, 'role', p.role, 'description', p.description, 'contribution', p.contribution, 'techStack', p.tech_stack, 'highlights', p.highlights, 'url', p.url ) ORDER BY p.start_date DESC) FROM project_experiences p WHERE p.user_id = u.id ), CAST('[]' AS json)) AS text) AS projects, CAST(COALESCE(( SELECT json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', a.id, 'name', a.name, 'awardDate', a.award_date, 'description', a.description ) ORDER BY a.award_date DESC) FROM awards a WHERE a.user_id = u.id ), CAST('[]' AS json)) AS text) AS awards FROM users u LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT id, content FROM skills WHERE user_id = u.id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) s ON TRUE WHERE u.id = #{userId}
